proposed_facts.reason: Canonical reset preparation always clears the queue but suppresses the ordinary executing callback only when Canceling is false. OSReboot supplies the callback that sets Prepared before apploader reads. The document preserves this conditional behavior.

Queued cancellation independently invokes block->callback(-3, block); cancel-all passes NULL only for the cancellation-request callback. Preparation clears the queue before its branch and routes the supplied callback as described. The reboot consumer waits on Prepared.

The exact old-style static void definition submits DVDLowRequestError and falls through. The low-level issuer registers the callback, starts the command, arms its timeout, and returns 1. Replacing misleading non-returning terminology is warranted.

Accepted replacement-disc identity leads to the metadata read whose completion invokes stateReadingFST. That state saves LastState, asserts alignment, and uses tmpBuffer metadata for the FST read. Independently inspected fstload.c confirms a separate boot sequence using public BS-read requests.

contradictions.reason: The two reset-preparation contradictions are resolved by proposal facts 0 and 1: pending cancellation does not suppress the ordinary command callback, and NULL cancellation callbacks do not suppress queued command callbacks.
The no-return contradiction is resolved by proposal fact 2; void return type does not imply non-returning execution.

The boot-time characterization is corrected by proposal fact 3. The internal state follows replacement-disc metadata completion; the separate boot loader uses public APIs. LastState resumption remains preserved.

Accept the five .bss fact and two .bss link deferrals. Buffer and alarm roles are supported, but source declarations do not establish compiled section ownership or order. The two blanket dummy-installation claims additionally require the motor-wait cancellation exception, which the document explicitly preserves.
Accept the five .data fact and one .data link deferrals. Source switches establish dispatch behavior, not required jump tables, code-pointer representation, or compiled .data contents.
Accept the five .sbss fact and one .sbss link deferrals. Persistent shared-state roles fit the declarations and scheduler, but exact section membership, compiled widths, and layout remain unverified.

Accept the six .sdata fact and one .sdata link deferrals. autoInvalidation is an authored integer policy initialized to 1, exchanged without normalization, consumed before queueing, and enabled by reboot. None of those observations proves that the entire compiled section target is this object.

unresolved: Accept the 21 section-fact and five section-link deferrals pending appropriate compiled evidence; source-level object behavior is not section-layout proof.
